blockingIssues.description: The Help menu still contains the upstream-branded `Zed Twitter` entry pointing at `https://twitter.com/zeddotdev` in `crates/zed/src/zed/app_menus.rs`, so this feature leaves a touched release-facing support surface presenting Zed rather than Neo Zed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Fix the custom droid model configuration used by scrutiny review subagents, or document a manual-review fallback when Task-based reviewers cannot launch.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both `scrutiny-feature-reviewer` Task invocations for `network-domain-topology-and-update-surfaces` and `support-feedback-and-release-service-rebrand` failed immediately with `Invalid model: custom:droidproxy:gpt-5.4`, so feature reviews had to be performed manually in this validator session.
